title.en: Story 11 — The Death of a Clerk

book_meta.work: short stories by Guy de Maupassant and Anton Chekhov
book_meta.author: Maupassant (d. 1893) and Chekhov (d. 1904)
book_meta.status: public domain — retold from the plots, no translation used

sentences.ar: بمسا حلو، إيفان تشيرفياكوف، موظف زغير، قاعد بالمسرح، بالصف التاني.
sentences.en: One fine evening, Ivan Chervyakov, a minor clerk, sat at the theatre, in the second row.

sentences.ar: وكان بيتفرج بالمنظار، وحاسس إنه أسعد إنسان بالدنيا.
sentences.en: And he was watching through opera glasses, feeling the happiest man alive.

sentences.ar: وفجأة... بس بالقصص بتصير كلمة فجأة كتير، بس هالمرة بمحلها.
sentences.en: And suddenly... but suddenly happens a lot in stories, and this time it fits.

sentences.ar: فجأة، وجهه تجعد، وعينه راحت لفوق، ونفسه وقف.
sentences.en: Suddenly, his face crumpled, his eyes rolled up, his breath stopped.
And he sneezed.
And sneezing is forbidden to no one.

sentences.ar: الفلاحين بيعطسوا، ورؤساء الشرطة بيعطسوا، وأحياناً حتى الوزرا.
sentences.en: Peasants sneeze, police chiefs sneeze, sometimes even ministers.
So he was not ashamed, and wiped his nose with his handkerchief.

sentences.ar: وتطلع حواليه، زي الرجل المهذب، يشوف إذا أزعج حدا.
sentences.en: And looked around, like a polite man, to see if he had disturbed anyone.
And here he was ashamed.

sentences.ar: قدامه، بالصف الأول، رجل عجوز، أصلع، بيمسح راسه ورقبته بقفازه، وبيتمتم.
sentences.en: In front of him, in the first row, an old man, bald, wiping his head and neck with his glove, and muttering.

sentences.ar: وعرفه تشيرفياكوف: الجنرال بريزجالوف، من وزارة المواصلات.
sentences.en: And Chervyakov knew him: General Brizzhalov, of the Ministry of Transport.
I sneezed on him, thought Chervyakov.
Not my superior, but a general.
Still, I must apologise.

sentences.ar: ومال لقدام، وهمس بأذنه: عفواً يا سعادتك، رشيت عليك...
sentences.en: And leaned forward, and whispered in his ear: excuse me, Your Excellency, I sprayed you...
I did not mean...
The general said: never mind.
Chervyakov said: for God's sake forgive me.
I did not mean...
The general said: enough, sit down!
Let me listen!

sentences.ar: وقعد تشيرفياكوف، وما عاد يشوف المسرح.
sentences.en: And Chervyakov sat, and no longer saw the stage.
He saw only the general.
And thought: he is angry.
Angry with me.
In the interval, he went to the general.

sentences.ar: وقال: يا سعادتك، أنا رشيت عليك، سامحني، ما كان قصدي...
sentences.en: And said: Your Excellency, I sprayed you, forgive me, I did not mean...

sentences.ar: قال الجنرال: يا سيدي، نسيت الموضوع، وإنت لسا فيه!
sentences.en: The general said: sir, I have forgotten the matter, and you are still on it!
And Chervyakov said to himself: forgotten?
But his eyes are hostile.
He does not want to talk.
I must explain to him.
And at home, he told his wife.

sentences.ar: ومرته قالت بالأول: أي، هاد إشي، بس روح اعتذر منه بالمكتب.
sentences.en: And his wife said at first: yes, it is something, but go and apologise at his office.

sentences.ar: وتاني يوم، حلق، ولبس بدلته، وراح للوزارة، ووقف بالطابور.
sentences.en: And the next day, he shaved, put on his suit, went to the ministry, and stood in the queue.

sentences.ar: ولما وصل دوره، قال: يا سعادتك، مبارح بالمسرح، إذا بتتذكر، عطست، و...
sentences.en: And when his turn came, he said: Your Excellency, yesterday at the theatre, if you recall, I sneezed, and...

sentences.ar: قال الجنرال: يا لك من... أي سخافة! شو بدك؟
sentences.en: The general said: what a... what nonsense! What do you want?

sentences.ar: وقال تشيرفياكوف بقلبه، ووجهه أبيض: ما بده يحكي معي.
sentences.en: And Chervyakov said to himself, his face white: he will not talk to me.
Angry.
I must explain.
He cannot stay like this.
And that same day, he went back to the ministry.

sentences.ar: قال: يا سعادتك، مش عشان أزعجك.
sentences.en: He said: Your Excellency, not to trouble you.
For the apology.

sentences.ar: أنا ما كان قصدي، لأنه العطس طبيعي...
sentences.en: I did not mean it, because sneezing is natural...

sentences.ar: وصرخ الجنرال، وهو بيرجف: إنت بتستهزئ فيّ؟
sentences.en: And the general shouted, shaking: are you mocking me?
Chervyakov said: mocking?
Me?
No, Your Excellency!
I only...
The general roared: get out!!
And stamped his foot, his face gone blue.

sentences.ar: ورجع تشيرفياكوف يمشي، بلا ما يشوف الطريق.
sentences.en: And Chervyakov walked home, without seeing the road.
Reached the house, and did not take off his suit.
Lay down on the sofa.
And died.
